text.p: MAPCO Inc said Wednesday its retail petroleum marketing unit, MAPCO Express, has acquired 20 retail convenience store locations from EZ-Serve Inc.
The 20 sites, primarily in Nashville, Tennessee, consist of 10 full-size stores and 10 mini-food marts.

MAPCO said the acquisition "increases our presence in the metropolitan Nashville area where, with our 72 locations, we are already recognized as the market leader. This is consistent with our plan to grow in targeted markets."

With the addition of the EZ-Serve locations, MAPCO Express markets petroleum products, convenience store merchandise and services through a network of 252 retail convenience stores and interstate travel centers in Alaska, Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee and Texas.
